title: Composites of YF3: Yb3+, Er3+, Tm3+@C3N4-Au with near-infrared light-driven ability for photocatalytic wastewater purification
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,764-776
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07018F, Paper
Open Access

Zuhuan Long, Yu Gao, Yaojun Zhang, Weili Ma, Jiqi Zheng, Yuxin Liu, Fu Ding, Yaguang Sun, Zhenhe Xu
YF@CN-Au core–shell composites with varying Au NPs amounts were developed to effectively utilize the entire solar spectrum, from UV to NIR, for the photodegradation of MO, thereby significantly enhancing solar energy utilization efficiency.
